task: Merge two ASCII XYZ point clouds: /home/user/Documents/left.xyz (200 points) and /home/user/Documents/right.xyz (300 points) into a single point cloud. Export the merged cloud as a binary little-endian PLY at /home/user/Documents/merged.ply containing all 500 points (200+300).

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
